definitions.explanation: the thin curved shape of the moon visible shortly after new moon or before the next new moon

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{空|ぞら}に{三日月|みかづき}が{浮|う}かんでいた。
examples.english: A crescent moon was floating in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {三日月|みかづき}の{形|かたち}をしたイヤリングを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought earrings shaped like a crescent moon.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{三日月|みかづき}がとても{明|あか}るく{輝|かがや}いている。
examples.english: Tonight the crescent moon is shining very brightly.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{三日|みっか} (third day) + {月|つき} (moon) → the moon on the third day of the lunar month, which appears as a thin crescent.

MOON PHASES:
- {新月|しんげつ} (new moon)
- {三日月|みかづき} (crescent moon)
- {半月|はんげつ} (half moon)
- {満月|まんげつ} (full moon)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The crescent moon shape is common in Japanese design, from family crests ({家紋|かもん}) to traditional crafts and modern accessories.
